paragraphs: He is mentioned in Ketubot 17b, saying in the name of Ze’iri. Hyman identifies him as the son of Rav Papa Saba, not of the well-known Rav Papa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The saved William Davidson Ketubot 17b paragraph names Surchav bar Pappa reporting Ze’iri but does not establish which Papa was his father. The exclusion of the famous Rav Papa and identification with Papa Saba are Hyman’s claims.

The whole Davidson Ketubot 17b paragraph names Surchav bar Pappa reporting in Ze’iri’s name. It does not establish which Papa was his father. Hyman’s exclusion of the famous Rav Papa and identification with Papa Saba retain their attribution and negation, alongside the existing note, without a fatherhood admission.
